announcements.intro: important stuff, slightly less important stuff, and things nobody asked for. check back now and then.
announcements.emptyText: nothing to announce right now. suspicious, honestly.
announcements.caughtUp: you are all caught up. go drink some water.

welcome.kicker: a tiny corner of the internet, for {name}
greetingsReturning: welcome back to the least necessary website.
welcome.intro: Salamu tu , to see how your day is going or juu ni usiku how it was today.. . Just you, me, and this slightly unnecessary website.
welcome.noteText: nilikosa kitu ya kuandika hapa lol.

checkin.heading: How are we actually doing today?
checkin.subheading: pick the one that's closest. no wrong answers. (ok, one wrong answer: ukidanganya.)

moods.label: Pretty good.
moods.description: Things are going suspiciously well. kila kitu iko sawa!!
responses: Love that for you. Write down whatever you did today so we can do it again.
Pretty good?? Look at you. Thriving. Iconic, honestly.
Okay, someone's day was good. Keep that energy, it suits you.
Noted. I'll be taking full credit for this, obviously.

moods.label: Just surviving.
responses: Usijali Surviving still counts. It's literally the main objective.
Some days are just 'get to the end' days, and you're doing it. Proud of you.
Surviving is underrated. Snacks and an early night are strongly recommended.
Respectable. Medium days build character, apparently.

moods.label: Uko karibu kulala ...
moods.description: Battery at 3%. Nalala saa hii. running on fumes
responses: Official instruction: water, food, and doing absolutely nothing for a bit.
Fumes are technically still fuel. But you deserve a full tank, so rest when you can.
You've been carrying a lot. Put some of it down tonight. It'll still be there tomorrow (sadly).
Low battery mode activated. Dim the brightness, close the unnecessary apps, lie down.

moods.label: Absolute chaos.
responses: Chaos? Want to tell me about it? I'm one text away.
Deep breath. The chaos is temporary. You, however, are permanent and great.
Okay, chaos coordinator. One thing at a time. The rest can wait its turn.
Sounds like a lot. Sending emotional support from right here.

tomorrow.heading: So… are we ready for tomorrow? coz me niko ready
tomorrow.note: usijali this is not a contract. nothing you click here can be used against you.

options.label: Yes, absolutely.
responses: Look at you, all prepared. Tomorrow doesn't stand a chance.
Confidence! I love it. tumeet kesho .

options.label: Mentally? No.
responses: Valid. Physically present is a great start. Mentally can join later.
Nobody's mentally ready for anything. We just show up and wing it.

options.label: We will figure it out.
responses: That's the spirit. Figuring it out is basically the whole plan of adulthood.
Exactly. And if it gets weird, ni life .

options.label: Can we reschedule life?
responses: I've filed the request. Life said no, but it offered snacks as compensation.
Unfortunately life is fully booked. You can, however, take a nap.

tomorrow.closingMessage: Whatever tomorrow looks like, Bora food iko sawa right?

extras.heading: From hapa ni AI sio mimi so ignore it please .
extras.intro: press a button, get a thing. that's the whole system.

lines: Your laugh is genuinely one of the best sounds.
You make hard things look easier than they are.
You have excellent taste. Evidence: you're reading this.
You're more appreciated than you know.
Drink some water. Yes, now.
Unclench your jaw. Drop your shoulders. There you go.
You're allowed to rest before you're exhausted.
Eat something that isn't just snacks. (Snacks also allowed.)
do we even have an inside joke? if we do then i'm sorry nilisahau

rps.heading: rock, paper, scissors?
rps.intro: winner gets bragging rights. loser also gets bragging rights. i'm not strict.
win: You won. I demand a rematch immediately.
Wow. Okay. Didn't want to win anyway.
lose: I win! Say it with me: Austine is the champion.
Ha! Maybe stick to being lovely instead.
Victory is mine. I'll be insufferable about it.
draw: A draw. We're too in sync.
rps.matchWin: Best of three goes to you. I'll be recovering privately.
rps.matchLose: Match goes to me. Better luck next time, champ.

welcome.intro: This is an official, legally binding* check-in. Answer honestly or I'll assume you're being dramatic. (*not legally binding)
welcome.noteText: property of the check-in department. do not lick.

checkin.heading: Status report, please.
checkin.subheading: choose carefully. this will go on your permanent record.

moods.label: Thriving.
responses: Disgusting. Share your secrets or leave.
Thriving? In this economy? Suspicious, but congrats.
Okay, main character. Don't let it go to your head.

moods.label: Mid.
moods.description: Neither good nor bad. Just… there.
responses: Mid is a valid lifestyle. Very beige of you.
A solid 5/10 day. Could've been worse, could've been Monday.
Mid days build character. You must have so much character by now.

moods.label: Low battery.
moods.description: Need a charger and a nap.
responses: Go lie down. That's not advice, it's an order.
Battery low? Have you tried turning yourself off and on again? (Sleep.)
Running on 2% and vibes. Respect, but please recharge.

moods.label: Unhinged.
moods.description: Do not perceive me right now.
responses: Understood. Perceiving has been paused. Text me when you're re-hinged.
Unhinged is just creative with extra steps.
Noted. I'll alert the authorities (me). I'm on my way with snacks.

tomorrow.heading: Ready for tomorrow or nah?
tomorrow.note: answers are non-binding and will be mocked lovingly regardless.

options.label: Born ready.
responses: Big talk. We'll see.
Love the confidence. Terrified for tomorrow, honestly.

options.label: Define 'ready'.
responses: 'Ready': a mythical state. Nobody has seen it.
If you have to ask, the answer is no. Same though.

options.label: I'll wing it.
responses: Classic. Winging it has a 100% success rate, as far as I know.
The flight plan is vibes. Bold strategy.

options.label: Tomorrow is cancelled.
responses: I've emailed tomorrow. It replied 'lol no'.
Request denied. Tomorrow is coming whether you like it or not.

tomorrow.closingMessage: That's the check-in done. You have been officially checked in on. Please rate your experience five stars.

extras.heading: The Department of Friendly Roasting
extras.intro: all roasts are gentle, organic, and served with love.

lines: You have the confidence of someone who's never checked the weather before going outside.
You reply to texts like they're a limited-edition release.
Your 'five more minutes' has never once been five minutes.
You're the reason group plans need a backup plan. Love you though.
NOTICE: You have been found guilty of being a decent friend. Sentence: continued friendship.
MEMO: Your vibes have been reviewed and approved. Please continue.
ALERT: Hydration levels unknown. Please drink water and report back.
(edit me) add your inside joke here
(edit me) never forget the incident
*slow clap*
I'm telling everyone.
Absolutely not. Anyway.
The audacity. I love it.
Noted, filed, and ignored.

rps.heading: settle it: rock, paper, scissors
rps.intro: loser has to admit the winner is right about everything. forever.
win: Fine. You win. Enjoy it, it won't last.
Okay, okay. One point. Don't get cocky.
lose: Was that your best? Be honest.
Another one for the trophy cabinet.
draw: Great minds, or just predictable ones?
rps.matchWin: You win the match. I'll be writing a strongly worded letter.
rps.matchLose: Match to me. Please collect your participation award.
